name: Pool Hall
hook: Solids or stripes. Clear your seven, then sink the 8.
how: Take turns on one felt table: drag back to aim and set power, let go to shoot. Pot a ball of your group to shoot again; a foul gives the other side ball in hand. Sink the 8 last to win. Three or four players split into two teams and rotate.
controls: Drag back from anywhere to aim and set power, let go to shoot (mouse or finger); arrow keys fine-tune, Space shoots
uses: Most wins, shown on the results card.
The host's browser runs every shot and applies the rules; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots shoot in the empty seats, and take over for anyone who leaves.
Everyone sees the shooter's cue move and the same roll, ball for ball.
ideas: Add a trick-shot mode with a target zone on the table
Make it a neon space table with glowing balls
Add a shot clock that gets shorter every turn
